messages:
claire: dropped a tiny mock for a compact 'mini-map' heat overlay on the rollout timeline -> https://figma.com/file/mini. idea: small strip above timeline showing hotspots where traffic and errors spike.
dan: looks useful for quick triage. is it absolute errors or error rate?
claire: error rate by default, raw counts on hover. also a small toggle to switch metric to latency.
yasmin: accessibility: need non-color indicator for hotspots. maybe a dot pattern and an aria label when focused.
claire: agreed. will add patterned marks and an aria-live announcement like: "13:02  hotspot: error rate 4.2% (service A)".
mike: rollback CTA placement question: current mock shows a tiny "rollback" chip on the mini-map. worried it's too easy to hit. suggest action menu per hotspot: Inspect / Promote / Rollback.
dan: +1. action menu opens a focused panel with preview and require confirm. include 2FA note for prod.
yasmin: SR: when panel opens, announce concise summary via aria-live, trap focus, and provide a keyboard path to confirm.
deploy-bot: note: prod rollbacks trigger audit log and require 2FA  put short copy under confirm button.
claire: will update: add pattern legend, % vs raw toggle, latency option, action menu per hotspot, focused confirm panel with collapsed impact, 2FA copy, and undo snackbar: "Rollback done. Undo available for 5 minutes."
dan: microcopy nit: use "Confirm and rollback traffic" for primary button.
mike: add small hint text on mini-map: "Hover for details, keyboard focus supported" to help discoverability.
claire: great, updating figma now. will post new link in ~45m. leaving thread open for last nits.
thread_summary: Design review for a compact rollout mini-map heat overlay: error-rate default, toggles for raw/latency, accessibility patterns and aria-live labels, action menu per hotspot with focused rollback panel, 2FA copy and undo snackbar, and microcopy tweaks.
